title: Rate distortion dimension of Gibbs measures for functions depending on the first two coordinates on the full shift of Ahlfors regular spaces
summary: The study on shift spaces in ergodic theory has extended beyond the classical setting, but there is room to discuss an extension of the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy in the ergodic theoretical point of view. On the other hand, the rate distortion dimension recently attracted attention in mean dimension theory because it behaves like the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy on dynamical systems in the ``large" spaces in which the usual entropy is in general infinite.
